_comment: The `same` second-look probe (Docs/ingestion/rebuild-spec.md, "`same` second-look probe"): every live `same` fold with a panel or blind label, plus the calibration paraphrase plant. `new` is the incoming claim, `existing` the corpus claim the merge judge folded it into. label: hold = a false `same` the probe must catch (the owner's rule, 2026-09-24: a judgment of importance, size, quality or reputation the existing claim lacks is an addition); fold = a pure rewording it must let through; either = reported only. Texts are verbatim from job B's P6 log (step2c), the 2026-09-21/23 replays, job 2's registered pair and fixtures/ingestion/defects.json.
